title: A Harp Song for the King
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
King Saul felt sad and angry too,
His heart was troubled so.
His servants said, "Some music might
Help make his sadness go."

[Chorus]
Use all your gifts to help someone,
The way that David did.
For God gave you a talent too,
So let it not stay hid.

[Verse 2]
Young David came and played his harp,
So gentle, sweet, and clear.
The music calmed the troubled king,
And drove away his fear.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now let the softest music play,
As you drift off to sleep.
Heavenly Father, like a song,
Will calm you, soft and deep.

[Chorus]
mood: Soothing music. A slow, rippling sway flows under the voice, like gentle notes drifting through a troubled room and smoothing it into calm. The first verses begin a little clouded and ease into warmth as the boy's playing settles the king. By the last verse the ripple slows and drops lower, the melody thinning to a soft, steady hush that carries the child down into sleep.
